Ethena USDe is a synthetic dollar stablecoin. Ethena USDe is backed by crypto collateral and hedging positions rather than fiat reserves held in a bank. Ethena USDe is issued on the Ethereum blockchain as a smart contract application.

Hyperliquid is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures trading. Hyperliquid runs on its own layer 1 blockchain. Hyperliquid uses an on-chain order book for trading.

Thorchain is a decentralized cross-chain liquidity protocol. Thorchain enables swaps of native assets across different blockchains without wrapping them. Thorchain uses its own native token, RUNE, and runs on its own blockchain.

Augur is a decentralized prediction market protocol. Augur is built as smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Augur uses its REP token to incentivize reporters who determine the outcomes of markets.

Ethereum Classic is a public blockchain that originated as a fork of Ethereum in 2016. Ethereum Classic supports smart contracts. Ethereum Classic uses a proof-of-work consensus mechanism.
